steps.en: The officer approves proceeding with the refund
steps.why_en: No approval action exists for refunds.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aksi approval untuk refund.

steps.en: A PLUS request to waive a paid notice is received
steps.id: Permintaan PLUS untuk waive notice terbayar diterima
steps.why_en: The request creates a refund record, but nothing continues to the payment gateway.
steps.why_id: Permintaan membuat record refund, tetapi tidak ada kelanjutan ke payment gateway.

steps.en: OCMS sends the offender ID or mobile number to the gateway
steps.id: OCMS mengirim ID atau nomor mobile offender ke gateway
steps.why_en: No such call exists; the only gateway call sends payments for reconciliation.
steps.why_id: Panggilan itu tidak ada; satu-satunya panggilan gateway mengirim pembayaran untuk rekonsiliasi.

steps.en: The gateway finds the PayNow account and refunds automatically
steps.id: Gateway menemukan akun PayNow dan refund otomatis
steps.why_en: This happens outside the repos and OCMS has no code that starts it.
steps.why_id: Ini terjadi di luar repo dan OCMS tidak punya code yang memulainya.
